'''Farrat Wrool''' was an insignificant [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who inexplicably turned into a rich [[Crime lord]] over night. [[Slicer/Legends|Slicers]] tried to hack his [[Computer/Legends|systems]] and uncover the mystery.<ref name="Mystery">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Mysterious Funds}}</ref>
